metadata.question: Was the surface color of Lake Ijssel near Kornwerderzand visibly greener than near Afsluitdijk on July 8, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 L2A SR over a small window around 2023-07-08 and the union of two ROIs: IJsselmeer near Kornwerderzand (east end of Afsluitdijk) and IJsselmeer near Den Oever (west end). If no images, widen window and then fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR.
2. Masking strategy: Apply cloud/shadow/cirrus mask. Then apply a water mask using NDWI > 0.05 to ensure only open water pixels are used.
3. Logic for valid vs null: Check collection size (C1), then valid pixel counts after masking (C2). Compute NDGB = (Green-Blue)/(Green+Blue). If mean is null/NaN or outside [-1, 1], return C3. Compare NDGB(Korn) - NDGB(Afs) > 0.03 => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const baseDate = '2023-07-08';
    const dayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    function rangeFor(base, windowDays) {
      const start = ee.Date(base).advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(base).advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); // end-exclusive
      return { start, end };
    }
    // ROIs (south side of Afsluitdijk, inside IJsselmeer)
    const roiKorn = ee.Geometry.Point([5.3410, 53.0600]).buffer(1500); // ~1.5 km
    const roiAfs = ee.Geometry.Point([5.0400, 52.9300]).buffer(1500);  // near Den Oever, lake side
    const roiUnion = roiKorn.union(roiAfs);

    // 2. Helper: async getInfo
    function getInfoAsync(obj) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(res);
        });
      });
    }

    // 3. Preprocessing functions
    function s2Preprocess(img) {
      // Cloud/shadow/cirrus mask using SCL + QA60
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const qa60 = img.select('QA60');
      const sclMask = scl.neq(3) // cloud shadow
        .and(scl.neq(8)) // medium cloud prob
        .and(scl.neq(9)) // high cloud prob
        .and(scl.neq(10)) // thin cirrus
        .and(scl.neq(11)); // snow/ice
      const cloudBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(10).int();
      const cirrusBitMask = ee.Number(2).pow(11).int();
      const qaMask = qa60.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0)
        .and(qa60.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      const scaled = img.updateMask(sclMask).updateMask(qaMask)
        .select(['B2','B3','B4','B8'])
        .multiply(0.0001) // scale reflectance
        .rename(['blue','green','red','nir'])
        .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
      return scaled;
    }
    function s2ApplyWaterMask(img) {
      const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['green','nir']);
      return img.updateMask(ndwi.gt(0.05));
    }

    function lsPreprocess(img) {
      // Landsat 8/9 L2 SR scaling and cloud mask
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
      const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
      const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
      const mask = cloud.not().and(cloudShadow.not()).and(cirrus.not()).and(snow.not());
      const scaled = img.updateMask(mask)
        .select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
        .rename(['blue','green','red','nir'])
        .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
      return scaled;
    }
    function lsApplyWaterMask(img) {
      const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['green','nir']);
      return img.updateMask(ndwi.gt(0.05));
    }

    function buildS2(start, end, geom) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    }
    function buildLS(start, end, geom) {
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      return l9.merge(l8);
    }

    // 4. Acquire data with fallback logic
    let dataset = 'S2';
    let windowDays = 0;
    let col = buildS2(rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).start, rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).end, roiUnion);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      windowDays = 3;
      col = buildS2(rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).start, rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).end, roiUnion);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      dataset = 'LS';
      windowDays = 7;
      col = buildLS(rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).start, rangeFor(baseDate, windowDays).end, roiUnion);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log(`Images: 0 within ±${windowDays} days (${dataset})`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Build mosaics: cloud-masked only, and water-masked
    let colCloudMasked, colWaterMasked;
    if (dataset === 'S2') {
      colCloudMasked = col.map(s2Preprocess);
      colWaterMasked = colCloudMasked.map(s2ApplyWaterMask);
    } else {
      colCloudMasked = col.map(lsPreprocess);
      colWaterMasked = colCloudMasked.map(lsApplyWaterMask);
    }
    const mosaicCloud = colCloudMasked.median();
    const mosaicWater = colWaterMasked.median();

    // 6. Compute NDGB image from water-masked mosaic
    const ndgb = mosaicWater.expression(
      '(g - b) / (g + b)', { g: mosaicWater.select('green'), b: mosaicWater.select('blue') }
    ).rename('ndgb');

    // 7. Counts and stats per ROI
    async function roiStats(roi) {
      const totalCount = await getInfoAsync(
        ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('constant')
      );
      const cloudFreeCount = await getInfoAsync(
        mosaicCloud.select('green').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('green')
      );
      const waterValidCount = await getInfoAsync(
        ndgb.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('ndgb')
      );
      const ndgbMean = await getInfoAsync(
        ndgb.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('ndgb')
      );
      return { totalCount, cloudFreeCount, waterValidCount, ndgbMean };
    }

    const statsK = await roiStats(roiKorn);
    const statsA = await roiStats(roiAfs);

    // 8. Validation for C2 and C3
    const anyImages = size;
    // if either ROI has 0 valid pixels after water mask, return C2
    if ((statsK.waterValidCount || 0) === 0 || (statsA.waterValidCount || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Images: ${anyImages} within ±${windowDays} days (${dataset})`);
      console.log(`Korn: total=${statsK.totalCount || 0}, cloudFree=${statsK.cloudFreeCount || 0}, waterValid=${statsK.waterValidCount || 0}`);
      console.log(`Afs:  total=${statsA.totalCount || 0}, cloudFree=${statsA.cloudFreeCount || 0}, waterValid=${statsA.waterValidCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    // Check NDGB validity
    function invalidVal(v) {
      return v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v) || v < -1.0 || v > 1.0;
    }
    if (invalidVal(statsK.ndgbMean) || invalidVal(statsA.ndgbMean)) {
      console.log(`Images: ${anyImages} within ±${windowDays} days (${dataset})`);
      console.log(`Korn NDGB: ${statsK.ndgbMean}, Afs NDGB: ${statsA.ndgbMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 9. Compute differences and print concise evidence
    const cloudFreePctK = statsK.totalCount ? (100 * (statsK.cloudFreeCount || 0) / statsK.totalCount) : null;
    const cloudFreePctA = statsA.totalCount ? (100 * (statsA.cloudFreeCount || 0) / statsA.totalCount) : null;
    const diff = statsK.ndgbMean - statsA.ndgbMean;
    const threshold = 0.03;

    console.log(`Images: ${anyImages} within ±${windowDays} days (${dataset})`);
    console.log(`Korn: total=${statsK.totalCount}, cloudFree=${statsK.cloudFreeCount} (${cloudFreePctK !== null ? cloudFreePctK.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%), waterValid=${statsK.waterValidCount}`);
    console.log(`Afs:  total=${statsA.totalCount}, cloudFree=${statsA.cloudFreeCount} (${cloudFreePctA !== null ? cloudFreePctA.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%), waterValid=${statsA.waterValidCount}`);
    console.log(`NDGB (green-blue): Korn=${statsK.ndgbMean.toFixed(4)}, Afs=${statsA.ndgbMean.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`Diff (K-A): ${diff.toFixed(4)}, Thresh=${threshold}`);

    // 10. Final Answer
    if (diff > threshold) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected errors (band names, memory, syntax)
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
